source_title: Morning Digest: GSLV places next-generation navigation satellite NVS-03 into orbit; INDIA bloc to hold ‘public impeachment’ of CEC Gyanesh Kumar today, and more
source_excerpt: GSLV places next-generation navigation satellite NVS-03 into orbit The Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV-F18) on Friday (October 30, 2026) successfully launched the NVS-03 satellite from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota, according to the ISRO. The GSLV-F18 with the NVS-03 satellite lifted off from the second launch pad of the spaceport and, 18 minutes later placed the satellite into the intended geosynchronous transfer orbit. GSLV places next-generation navigation satellite NVS-03 into orbit storyline 1 INDIA bloc’s ‘public impeachment’ of CEC postponed to October 31 due to rain: Rahul Gandhi The Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance (INDIA) bloc’s proposed “public impeachment” of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar has been postponed to Saturday afternoon (October 31, 2026) due to unfavourable weather conditions in New Delhi. The INDIA bloc said its planned “public impeachment” over alleged electoral manipulation through the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls will avoid imagery that could be seen as mocking Parliament as an institution. Supreme Court seeks report from ECI on Form 7 misuse allegations The Election Commission of India (EC) told the Supreme Court on Friday (October 30, 2026) that though it found “false” Form 7s for deletion of voters during the Uttar Pradesh Special Intensive Revision (SIR), none of them were accepted. Appearing before a Bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant, senior advocate Dama Seshadri Naidu, for the ECI, said corrective measures were taken promptly on discovery of such “false” forms. Authorities had rejected Form 7s filed in violation of norms, the ECI said. As per police officials, the incident took place around 9.30 p.m. on Friday (October 30, 2026) at B-293/294, Mangolpuri Industrial Area, Phase-1. At least four dead in fire at shoe factory in Delhi’s Mangolpuri Industrial Area storyline 1 Helicopter sorties were allowed despite orange alert and CMO advice to regulate tourists, says activist Friday’s (October 30, 2026) helicopter crash on the Badrinath-Dehradun route, which killed six people, including the pilot, has brought Uttarakhand’s helicopter safety regulations under fresh scrutiny, particularly the decision to allow flights despite weather warnings issued for the region. Activist Anoop Nautiyal said the tragedy was particularly disturbing as weather warnings had been issued in advance. An orange alert (for heavy to very heavy rainfall and snowfall) had been issued for five districts, including Chamoli, for October 30. The remarks from the Chief Minister came in response to a statement made by the Diamond Harbour MP, in which he alleged political vendetta and cautioned a section of police officers not to target him at the behest of the Chief Minister Suvendu challenges Abhishek to contest from Diamond Harbour in 2029 Lok Sabha polls storyline 1 Heavy polling in second phase panchayat elections for Sarpanch, Ward Panch in Rajasthan A heavy polling took place in the second phase of village panchayat elections for Sarpanch and Ward Panch in 22 districts of Rajasthan on Friday (October 30, 2026). While 45 Sarpanches were earlier elected unopposed, as many as 3,626 village panchayats went to polls and 1.06 crore voters exercised their franchise. The highest voter turnout was recorded at 84.37% in Jaipur district’s Rampura Dabri. Heavy polling in second phase panchayat elections for Sarpanch, Ward Panch in Rajasthan storyline 1 Rain fails to dampen spirits as thousands turn up for Diljit Dosanjh’s Delhi concert, marking beginning of Aura World Tour The rain-soaked Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium in Delhi turned into a sea of white turbans, music and cheers on Friday (October 30, 2026) evening as thousands of fans braved hours of rain to catch Punjabi singer Diljit Dosanjh perform in the capital. The excitement was visible as early as 3 p.m., with fans arriving in groups, some dressed in Dosanjh’s popular white and black kurta-pyjama and turban combination. Several women, too, sported white turbans with their outfits.
